mechanism: Both drugs have CNS depressant effects; pregabalin increases GABAergic activity while nalmefene (opioid antagonist) may paradoxically potentiate CNS depression when used in alcohol use disorder treatment contexts with concurrent sedating agents.
action: Monitor for excessive sedation, dizziness, and impaired cognition; dose adjustment of pregabalin may be warranted; counsel on avoiding alcohol and hazardous activities.
